description: This file defines classes and methods related to workflow processing in the SmartClient framework, including classes like ProcessElement, ProcessSequence, Task, ServiceTask, ScriptTask, XORGateway, DecisionGateway, and UserTask, with associated methods for workflow execution and task management.

classes.name: ProcessElement
classes.description: Base class for workflow process elements.

classes.name: ProcessSequence
classes.description: Represents a sequence of process elements, inherits from ProcessElement.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Base class for tasks within a process, inherits from ProcessElement.

classes.name: ServiceTask
classes.description: Represents a service task that performs data source operations, inherits from Task.

classes.name: ScriptTask
classes.description: Represents a script execution task, inherits from Task.

classes.name: XORGateway
classes.description: Exclusive OR gateway for decision making in workflows, inherits from ProcessElement.

classes.name: DecisionGateway
classes.description: Decision gateway for branching workflows based on criteria, inherits from ProcessElement.

classes.name: UserTask
classes.description: User interaction task, inherits from Task.

methods.name: getElement
methods.description: Retrieves a process element by ID.

methods.name: $87g
methods.description: Recursive search for an element by ID within nested sequences and elements.

methods.name: $39n
methods.description: Gets the next element to execute in the process.

methods.name: $87i
methods.description: Goes to a specific element by ID.

methods.name: $87j
methods.description: Finds the next element in the execution stack.

methods.name: $87h
methods.description: Retrieves the first task in the current execution context.

methods.name: setNextElement
methods.description: Sets the next element to execute.

methods.name: executeElement
methods.description: Executes a specific task or process element.
